Aisha: Morning triage — quick check-in. Volume up ~30% from baseline (approx 95 -> 125 open tickets). Two P1-ish items: auth gateway 503s and a deduped webhook flood. I'm going to focus on macros + routing for now.
Ben: Confirmed — I counted 38 new tickets since 03:00 UTC. Breakdown: 24 general support, 9 infra, 5 billing. No customer escalations yet. Queue backlog = 12 unassigned.
Carlos: Saw spike in upstream auth gateway, error signature `auth_gateway.v2: 503 x-fwd` — looks like token cache expiry + k8s pod churn. I've added an alert note. @oncall-sre please take a look, linking incident playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/auth-gateway :eyes:
Morgan: I'll update the "auth-gateway" macro now. New snippet proposed:
```
Problem: 502/503 from auth-gateway
Steps:
1) Check pods + logs: `kubectl -n infra get pods` and `kubectl logs -l app=auth-gw --tail=200`
2) If token-cache errors, restart cache: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-cache`
3) If error rate >100/min escalate to SRE, include last 50 auth error lines and deployment diff
4) Temp mitigation: increase cache TTL if safe for dedicated customers (follow infra guidance)
```
Aisha: Thanks. Make sure the macro includes the playbook link above and a note to cc Security for Dedicated customers. Also add a line about capturing `x-request-id` headers for noisy flows.
Ben: Small request — can we add a quick repro curl for support to attach logs? e.g., `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/health -v`
Morgan: Done — updated macro saved as `macro:AuthGateway-503` and added repro example + playbook. Tested formatting in the macro editor. :thumbsup:
triage-bot: Auto summary — new tickets: 38, open: 125, P1s: 2, active responders: Aisha, Ben, Morgan, Carlos. Report: https://redwood.internal/support/reports/176990
Carlos: I'll pick up the webhook-flood follow-up (likely retry storm from Partner X). Starting tracing and will add findings to ticket #8672.
Aisha: Blockers: need SRE to confirm whether bumping cache TTL is safe vs rolling back recent cache change. If we can't bump TTL, we may need temporary rate-limits on token refresh endpoints. I'll ping infra lead in 10m.
Ben: Assigning tickets — I'll triage 10 and tag customers for status updates. Please add any macros you used to ticket templates so CS gets consistent messaging.
Morgan: Noted — I'll append macro IDs to the ticket comment template and add a short TL;DR for CS.
Aisha: Thanks team. Follow-ups: Carlos on webhook tracing, Morgan on macro + ticket templates, Ben on triage assignments. I'll update this thread if infra replies. :eyes:
